data.key: Lion Blade ~ Move with the Crowd
data.name: Move with the Crowd
data.description: When moving through groups of intelligent Small, Medium, or Large creatures that would normally count as difficult terrain, the Lion Blade instead moves normally. In addition, she gains a +5 competence bonus on Acrobatics checks to avoid attacks of opportunity or move through an enemy's square when moving faster than half speed.
